role: The monster egg (97): a stone, cobblestone or stone-brick lookalike that spawns a silverfish when broken and drops nothing; the static maps between host blocks and egg metas used by the silverfish AI and worldgen.

members.name: BlockSilverfish
members.note: row 97: clay-like material, hardness 0.75 in the registry (the ctor's 0 is overridden by Blocks' setHardness)

members.name: getIcon
members.note: the oracle dumps getIcon for every (id, meta, side) into rb_table.icon_index; table_icon reads it

members.name: onBlockDestroyedByPlayer
members.note: the fish spawn after removeBlock; survival.c constructs it in the live server

members.name: quantityDropped
members.note: BlockSilverfish overrides dropBlockAsItemWithChance (it spawns the silverfish) without quantityDropped

members.name: func_150195_a
members.note: the host to egg meta map, inlined

members.name: func_150197_b
members.note: Read only by EntitySilverfish's ally summon when doMobGriefing is false (the egg is put back as its host block); the supported gamerules are doDaylightCycle and keepInventory, so survival play keeps mobGriefing true and the egg is broken instead (func_147480_a, ported).

members.name: createStackedBlock
members.note: Stone, cobblestone or a stone brick variant by metadata; the silk-touch break still spawns the fish from onBlockDestroyedByPlayer, whose constructor draws come before the drop (dig.c:dig_fish).

members.name: dropBlockAsItemWithChance
members.note: the second fish (fish B) in place of a drop

notes: Eggs generate in extreme hills veins (decorator.c hills_post) and stronghold corridors. harvestdrops.c excludes block 97 from its probe on purpose. func_150197_b's use was inferred from silverfish_spawn_from_egg's name, not traced line by line. lane/idxblocks: idx-blocks-s1 hand-digs a stone monster egg and the silverfish comes out.
